title: Extension Pack Control Hooks Are Available
summary: Extension packs should use typed control hook declarations instead of legacy lifecycle scripts or ad hoc runtime callbacks.
agent_instruction: When creating or updating an extension pack, declare control hooks in the pack manifest and validate them with greentic-pack doctor. Do not add untyped lifecycle scripts for control behavior.
human_summary: Extension packs now have typed control hook declarations for runtime behavior.

new_capabilities.title: Extension Pack Control Hooks
new_capabilities.summary: Typed control hooks can be registered in extension pack manifests and validated before bundle assembly.

deprecated_commands.reason: Control behavior should be declared as typed hooks in the pack manifest.

replaced_guidance.old_guidance: Add lifecycle scripts directly to extension packs for control behavior.
replaced_guidance.replacement_guidance: Declare typed control hooks in the extension pack manifest and validate them with greentic-pack doctor.
replaced_guidance.reason: Typed hooks are discoverable by bundle assembly and safer for agents to modify.

migration_steps.instruction: Add typed control hook declarations to the extension pack manifest.
Run bundle validation if the extension pack is already consumed by a bundle.
